overall_intent: An intimate expedition portrait whose seated pilot visibly inhabits a giant machine in a dry former sea, keeping the referenced facial and hair appearance within an open chest cockpit.

object_structure.reason: The human-sized seat bay must visibly belong to a larger machine torso.
object_structure.expressive_goal: Show a believable open cockpit as a bounded interior of the expedition walker, rather than a detached seat beside a prop.
observable_targets: open chest hatch and seat bay
articulated machine leg reaching salt ground
owner_relations: near leg connects machine torso to ground
required_constraints: Use the supplied portrait as the pilot's facial and hair appearance reference.
open_scope: machine-part connections and visible leg structure
object_structure.role_focus: An open chest cockpit inside an expedition walker: a seated human pilot is enclosed by a larger machine torso, with a clearly bounded hatch and connected leg structure.
object_structure.scene_context: A quiet daylight pause on cracked salt beside a stranded buoy; the exterior view keeps the pilot and machine together.

grounds.quote: Human pilot seated inside a giant mechanical walker

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: This role develops the authored machine architecture and containment relation; it does not turn specific mechanics into requester requirements.

scale_relation.reason: A recognizable person inside the machine provides a direct human-to-machine size comparison.
scale_relation.expressive_goal: Let the pilot and torso share one depth plane while a connected leg shows the machine reaches the ground far below.
observable_targets: near leg reaching the salt bed
owner_relations: human pilot smaller than enclosing machine torso
pilot and cockpit at the same physical depth
near machine leg continuously reaches the ground
required_constraints: preserve the reference face and hair appearance
scale_relation.role_focus: A human pilot seated inside a much larger machine chest, physically enclosed at the same depth as the hatch, with a connected leg descending to dry ground as a scale cue.
scale_relation.scene_context: The camera is level with the chest cockpit from an exterior platform, showing a three-quarter torso and near leg in clear afternoon light.

grounds.quote: Human pilot seated inside a giant mechanical walker

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: The comparison has actual entities and a stated containment/depth basis; it is not a claim of an exact machine height or a new reference-body fact.
